context: Experience applying the current agent ruleset exposed gaps between intended behavior and observed execution.
intent: Provide a mechanism to develop a new agent ruleset, spawned from the current one, based on observed metrics.
recommendation: Use Darwin to derive a candidate from a pinned current ruleset, connect proposed changes to observed metrics, trial it against a recorded baseline and retain version history. Activate changes only with user approval.
verification: The user clarified this lesson on 2026-10-10. Existing evaluations record execution and tracking gaps; the ruleset-development mechanism has not yet been trialled and its benefits remain unverified.
openQuestions: Which observed metrics should guide candidate changes?
Which trial cases and success conditions should assess the candidate?
Where should the spawned ruleset be developed and trialled?
